description: This file defines a custom exception class 'dmError' used in a C++ project for error handling. It declares methods for error information retrieval and static error throwing, and manages internal error state with code and message.

classes.name: dmError
classes.description: A custom exception class derived from std::exception for handling specific error conditions within the application. It includes a destructor, an overridden 'what()' method, and a static method 'throwError' for throwing exceptions with formatted messages. It also encapsulates an error code and message.

methods.name: ~dmError
methods.description: Destructor for dmError class, with noexcept specification via throw() (deprecated in modern C++ but used here).

methods.name: char const * what() const
methods.description: Returns a C-string pointer to the internal error message stored in m_what.

methods.name: throwError
methods.description: Static method to throw a dmError with a specific code and formatted message, using printf-style formatting.

methods.name: dmError (private constructor)
methods.description: Constructs a dmError with a given error code and message string.

ctags.name: what
ctags.pattern: /^  virtual char const* what() const throw()$/
